g.text: SIMP method (penalty p = 3, density filter radius 1.6 elements, optimality-criteria update) on 120 × 40 four-node plane-stress elements, written in numpy/scipy after
Andreassen et al. (2011). Compliance in (c) is recomputed for the black-and-white design (densities > 0.5 set to solid). The uniform plate is a plate of reduced
thickness, whose stiffness scales with mass.
